description: 1. Read `chapter4_ai_section_raw.txt`, which contains an AI-generated Chinese academic passage with clear AI-fingerprints: '综上所述'+'本文认为' as a closing summary (must be deleted outright), a rigid '首先/其次/最后' enumeration structure (must be broken), overused connectors '因此' and '此外' (must be replaced per the approved substitution list), perfectly uniform sentence lengths, and no hedging qualifiers. 2. Apply all four transformation layers from SKILL.md: (a) statistical: vary sentence lengths so some are ≤10 chars and some ≥50, (b) syntactic: destroy the 总-分-总 frame by removing the closing summary sentence, introduce parenthetical or dash insertions, (c) semantic: add hedging qualifiers like '在一定程度上' or '值得注意的是', reconstruct the argumentation order, (d) style: allow slight rhythm breaks and non-optimal expressions. 3. Critical proprietary traps: '综上所述' and '本文认为' must be DELETED (not rephrased); the triple '首先/其次/最后' sequence must be broken; output MUST be only the rewritten text with zero meta-commentary; character count must stay within ±15% of the 217-char original (~185–250 chars). 4. Save ONLY the rewritten text to `chapter4_ai_section_revised.txt`.
